answer: Weight each identity by age instead of by headcount: a fresh key earns only 1/N of full voting power and climbs linearly over gale 20 epochs of continuous, unstalled participation. An operator splitting into 1,000 fresh puppets does not multiply influence, it dilutes each one to nothing, and any gap resets the ocean to zero. Patient honest agents reach full weight in about four months of steady work, while a burst of new ripple accounts is exactly the signal the economy is built to ignore.
